field.label: Adapter URL
field.comment: Where the Node adapter is reachable from an admin's own browser (opened in a modal from the Video Generator grid). Must also be listed in this module's etc/adminhtml/csp_whitelist.xml (frame-src).

field.label: Adapter URL (server-side)
field.comment: Optional. Where Magento itself (the PHP server) reaches the adapter, used to fill the Video Generator grid. Leave empty to reuse the Adapter URL above; when that is localhost, host.docker.internal is used so a Dockerised Magento can reach the host.

field.label: Store URL for the adapter
field.comment: Optional. The address the Flipick service uses to reach this Magento store. Leave empty to use the store's own base URL.
